title: 12 Best Vegan Restaurants in Casablanca
description: Discover Casablanca's top vegan restaurants, from healthy acai bowls to authentic Moroccan tagines and gourmet burgers. Find the best spots for every budget and occasion in Morocco's vibrant city.

places.name: L'Organic Kitchen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Green Power Bowl' with quinoa, avocado, various greens, and a tahini dressing, or their daily vegan tart.

places.name: Acai Spot
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Classic Acai Bowl' with fresh fruits and granola, or an 'Avocado Toast' on whole-wheat bread.

places.name: BFF (Burger Frites Forever)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Vegan Supreme Burger' with a side of sweet potato fries.

places.name: N'Thai
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Vegetable Green Curry with tofu (ensure no fish sauce) or Pad See Ew with tofu.

places.name: O'wok
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A custom wok with rice noodles, mixed vegetables, tofu, and a peanut or soy-ginger sauce.

places.name: La Sqala
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Vegetable Tagine (confirm no animal broth or butter) or a platter of Moroccan salads and 'Zaalouk' (eggplant dip).

places.name: The Brunch Factory
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Avocado Toast (ask for no egg/dairy) with a fresh fruit smoothie, or a customized 'build your own' salad.

places.name: Roots Moroccan Kitchen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Vegetable and Chickpea Harira' (ensure no meat broth) and their daily special vegan main, often a creative take on a traditional stew.

places.name: Bombay Palace
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Dal Makhani (ensure no cream/butter), Aloo Gobi, Chana Masala, and vegan Roti (flatbread).

places.name: Senza Glutine
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Gluten-free pasta with a fresh tomato basil sauce and roasted vegetables, or a custom-made vegan salad.

places.name: Le Cabestan Ocean View
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A custom-prepared vegetable risotto (ensure no butter/cheese), or a beautifully plated seasonal vegetable and grain dish by request.

places.name: The Kozy Bar & Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Buddha Bowl' (confirm vegan dressing) or a custom vegetable pasta with a marinara sauce.
